releases.title: First release
notes: Restrict vehicles by job and grade, duty, gang, ACE permission or whitelist.
The server checks drivers itself, and removes anyone who drives a stopped vehicle anyway.
Manage whitelists in game with /vehicleaccess, by server ID, citizen ID or Discord ID.
Supports Qbox (including multiple jobs) and QBCore.
